subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, or should tool progress stay in loading messages, preview/native task-card progress, and opt-in status reactions?
rationale: Source inspection proves the wiring gap, but exposing active tool labels through Slack native status is a user-visible disclosure/default choice that overlaps the open Slack-safe progress visibility issue and multiple existing Slack progress surfaces.

options.title: Decide Policy First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle the Slack native-status disclosure/default policy with the Slack-safe progress visibility work.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Allow a narrow Slack-owned implementation that derives labels from the shared progress display model, dedupes unchanged writes, clears reliably, and includes redacted live Slack proof.

options.title: Keep Native Status Generic
options.body: Close or narrow this request only if maintainers decide native Slack status should remain generic and tool detail belongs solely in existing progress surfaces.

recommendation.title: Decide Policy First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle the Slack native-status disclosure/default policy with the Slack-safe progress visibility work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent maintainer involvement in the adjacent Slack native-status default and loading-message decisions.
